hotels.title: Five-Star Seafront Resort the Gateway to Agadir with Regal Design & Fine Dining
hotels.description: Indulge in a resort with a reputation that precedes itself and boasts the refined design of a French-inspired Moroccan palace. Poised on the shores of Agadir Beach, this Sofitel brings five-star luxury to a famously laidback city of fresh seafood, surf and traditional Souks. From an enormous palm-lined pool to the sultry Soul Club, there's plenty of room to escape the kids or the city chaos, along with a revitalised Spa fresh from a total makeover. The entire resort was refurbished in 2024, and it shows. The Squid restaurant impresses with mature design elements and a punchy menu of fine fare. Elsewhere, Zaytoune, La Voile Blanche, Soul Restaurant and several trendy bars offer a range of comfortable atmospheres and casual dining. Outside the walls of this royal palace, discover the Oufella Ruins or authentic handicrafts at Souk El Had for a true taste of Moroccan culture.
